title: Agent Sessions Silently Missed Prompt Cache
caption:
I fanned out subagents all week and never once checked whether they were hitting cache.

Claude Code 2.1.261 and 2.1.265 fixed three ways agent sessions silently broke prompt-cache reuse: a resumed subagent changing its own tool list and system prompt prefix, hook context and preloaded skills sliding out of the prefix on later turns, teammates re-announcing their tools on turn two. A cache miss doesn't throw. It just bills.

I trust my token numbers a lot less than I did on Monday.

Do you check yours?

slides.title: Where The Prefix Broke
items: Resuming a foreground-spawned subagent changed its tool list and system prompt prefix. Cache reuse gone.
Teammates and resumed subagents moved SubagentStart hook context and preloaded skills out of the prefix.
In-process teammates re-announced their tools and skills on turn two. Prefix changed.

slides.title: Now /cost Says Why
slides.sub: 2.1.260 started naming the cause — changed tools, changed system prompt, idle past the TTL.
